profile.headline: SWE L3 @ F5 | Go Expert & Rust Aficionado | Skilled in k8s, Helm, Terraform | Passionate about Writing Clear, Maintainable Code | Let’s build robust and efficient applications together! 🚀
profile.summary:
As an L2 Software Engineer at F5 in Seattle, WA, I focus on cloud computing and infrastructure, leveraging Golang, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and gRPC to create scalable solutions.

I have a knack for drilling deep into technology to resolve complex issues has proven invaluable. This ability to dissect and understand complex systems underscores my passion for learning and applying new technologies and techniques. My adaptability and quick learning ability are key strengths.

In team environments, I emphasize clear communication, flexibility, and value diverse perspectives. When seeking opportunities in the tech industry, I prioritize remote work options and collaboration with like-minded peers.

Beyond my professional interests, I have a growing passion for Rust and aim to integrate it more into my work. In my leisure time, I enjoy strategy and resource management games like Satisfactory, Kerbal Space Program, and Astroneer.

I aim to advance to Software Engineer Level 3, focusing on Rust and connecting with fellow tech enthusiasts. Let's connect and exchange ideas on technology, innovation, or just to share interesting ideas in the field of cloud computing, Rust or Kubernetes.

positions.description:
Cloud Native Computing Foundation Projects involving Kubernetes.
